grader: silos.nn_core: per-row scaled MAE (declared scales) on the shared test set

target.unit: shared-test rows scored (a measurement: the MAE is in the result details, there is no pass bar)

test_set_sha256: <sha256 of the shared test file in the AWS-generated data tree (manifest.json of silos.job_data)>

details.note: Final aggregate of the FL service session with differential privacy (record-level DP-SGD per simulated silo) scored on the shared test set. A measurement; reported relative to the non-DP federated model in a separate run.
details.population: simulated silos: three simulated operators on the in-process Maveric twin, run in one account; not partner data

privacy.caveat: Reading the framework code, its accountant counts local_epochs x rounds sampled steps, while a local epoch over the silo's data is n // 256 optimizer steps. We state the service's epsilon as the declared one and report our recomputation next to it; the offline numbers are estimates from code, not measurements of a run.
privacy.delta: (training-set size)^-2 per silo, fixed by the FL service's framework
privacy.epsilon_recomputed_counting_every_optimi: <fill: offline estimate with silos.dp_accounting.standard_epsilon: A 4.4, B 7.2, C 4.3>
privacy.epsilon_reported_by_the_service: <fill from the session: the service's own figure; offline estimate for 20 rounds x 1 local epoch, batch 256, noise multiplier 1 / 1 / 2: A 2.2, B 2.8, C 1.5>
privacy.planning_value_not_used: delta = 1e-5 (the service does not take a delta)
privacy.source: privacy_budget() override in the model-code class; Opacus per-sample clipping with a Renyi-DP accountant, noise on each silo's update (record-level DP-SGD per silo)
